name: SurveyAnswer
description: Normalised per-question survey answer row, written server-side at submission time. One row per score field answered (or marked N/A) in a survey submission. All scoring values are computed server-side from the published survey version, never from client input.

survey_version_id.description: Published survey version the answer was validated against

field_id.description: Score field id within the version snapshot

reporting_name.description: Short reporting name copied from the field config

reporting_category.description: Reporting category copied from the field config

raw_score.description: Raw value the respondent selected (null when N/A)

is_na.description: True when the respondent chose Not Applicable

normalised_score.description: 0..1 normalised score after reverse-scoring inversion (null when N/A)

weight.description: Question weight from the version snapshot

weighted_contribution.description: normalised_score * weight (null when excluded from overall)

included_in_overall.description: Whether this answer counted towards the overall score denominator
